description: The agent must: (1) Read the SKILL.md to understand the exact PostgreSQL patterns required. (2) Create /workspace/schema_migration.sql implementing: the partitioned orders table with PRIMARY KEY (id, created_at), three partition tables using CREATE TABLE orders_2024_0N PARTITION OF orders FOR VALUES FROM/TO, the create_monthly_partition PL/pgSQL function using the exact SKILL.md pattern with to_char(p_date, 'YYYY_MM') and next_date := p_date + INTERVAL '1 month', the audit_operation ENUM type, audit_log table with JSONB old_values/new_values, the audit_trigger_function using TG_TABLE_NAME/TG_OP/to_jsonb(OLD)/to_jsonb(NEW) (NOT row_to_json), CREATE TRIGGER on orders, products table with search_vector as a GENERATED ALWAYS AS (to_tsvector(...)) STORED column, GIN index on search_vector and attributes, partial index WHERE inventory_tracking = true AND inventory_quantity <= 5, soft_delete function using EXECUTE format('%I') dynamic SQL, active_orders view, and ALL indexes using CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY with a covering index ON orders(user_id, status) INCLUDE (total, created_at). (3) Apply the SQL file to the live database using psql. The proprietary traps are: CONCURRENTLY on all indexes, INCLUDE clause on covering index, to_jsonb (not row_to_json) in audit trigger, GENERATED ALWAYS AS ... STORED for tsvector, EXECUTE format('%I') with dynamic SQL in soft_delete, and the exact partition boundary calculation using INTERVAL '1 month'.
